title: Can't load/save setting on SD Card
body:
Hello

I change my Z5C with Android 7.1 with a Samasung XCover 4S Android Pie.

I would like to load my old setting but impossible , so i add all setting that i have on my Sony, after i would like to save to SD Card , Xdrip say setting save in SDCard Downloads but i can't find the folder .

So i make a folder Downloads to my SD Card and try but nothing .

I verify Xdrip app autorisation and all are ok 

Thanks

comments.body:
I had the same „issue“
The point is, that xDrip stores everything to integrated memory, but names it SD Card. I see this as confusing, too. 

Especially if you reset your phone. Exporting everything and removing the SD Card afterwards, is a huge failure.
Thanks Dainem21 i find files on internal memory , file on Folder Download/xDrip-export

@mick711 Sounds like your problem is resolved.  Would you please close the issue?
Thanks
